6.3.4 Professional Issues 
From a professional angle, the project was built and designed with the British 
Computer Societies (BCS) guidelines in mind (BCS, n.d.). These ideologies 
ensure the applications design and functionality are within the public’s interest 
and are ensuring equal access for all students. The applications quality should be 
a critical aspect at all stages of development, from initial coding to how it is 
presented to students during the investigation; ensuring the reputation of the 
product is not tainted. 
6.4 Synoptic Reflections 
Reflecting on my academic journey at Nottingham Trent University, this final 
year project has been the culmination of all my academic growth during my 
tenure; and professional insights gained during my placement year at Dyson. 
During my professional life, I aspire to become a cloud architect or a mobile 
developer. The integration of AWS cloud with the project’s architecture within 
the implementation phase of this project, aligns closely with the competencies 
and knowledge expected by a cloud architect. 
My projects front-end that utilised Android Java, is very much a reflection of my 
desires to become a mobile developer. Creating applications such as this offers  
critical examples which enable employers to see what I am capable of. These 
examples, not only demonstrate my capabilities as a software engineer but as a 
UI designer, which highlights the creativity needed to become a mobile 
developer. This project has helped teach me a considerable amount, about the 
complex skills needed for this career path.
